prompt:
Fix snippets/trial-period-banner.liquid so it renders the subscription trial banner exactly as specified. Inputs: - `subscription` is a top-level object and is never null. All of its keys are always present: - `subscription.status`: string or null. - `subscription.plan`: string or null. - `subscription.days_left`: integer or null. It may be zero or negative. - `subscription.coupon`: string or null. All string matching is exact and case-sensitive, with no trimming and no substring matching. Rules: 1. Output nothing (an empty string) unless `subscription.status` is exactly `trialing`. For example, `Trialing`, `TRIALING`, `trialing-paused` and null all produce no output. 2. Plan label: - `basic` gives `Basic`. - `pro` gives `Pro`. - `enterprise` gives `Enterprise`. - Any other value gives `Free`. This includes null, `Pro`, `BASIC` and ` pro` with a leading space. 3. Let D be `days_left`, with null treated as 0. 4. Message: - If D <= 0: `Your trial ends today`. - If D == 1: `1 day left in your trial`. - Otherwise: `D days left in your trial`, with D as an integer. 5. The banner is `
LABEL trialMESSAGECOUPON
`. - Write it with no whitespace between tags. - CLASSES is `trial-banner`, followed by ` trial-banner--urgent` when D <= 3. This includes 0, negative values and null. - COUPON is `Code: VALUE`, where VALUE is the HTML-escaped coupon. Output it only when `coupon` is neither null nor the empty string. Otherwise omit it entirely. Use only core Liquid. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/trial-period-banner.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
